s1: This is Bexley. One pool of Near, split into two tokens. bee-ex USD holds one dollar, and earns. ex-Near is leveraged Near.
s1b: And there are no liquidations. Ever.
s2: You deposit Near, and pick a side. Every mint happens at fair value, so nobody else's position moves.
s3: Your portfolio shows everything you hold, in dollars. And exactly how much it moves, when Near moves.
s4: Or just ask. Bexley's AI, running on Near AI, turns plain English into a plan, with the result and the main risk. Nothing happens until you approve it.
s5: An AI Guardian runs the pool every five minutes, inside hard limits, with a key that can't move funds. Every decision is signed in Near AI's secure hardware, and your browser checks the proof.
s6: We tested it. We pushed Near down thirty-seven percent. The safety rails slowed the fall. The AI raised fees. Then the Stability Pool stepped in, and lifted backing back to a hundred and forty percent. bee-ex USD held one dollar, the whole time.
s7: And with Near Intents, bring USDC, ETH, SOL, or Bitcoin from other chains, straight into Bexley. No bridging.
s8: Bexley. Leverage, with no liquidations. Built on Near.
